versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Hannah & Elena client skill for Serviceplan AI coworker integration
- Connects to specialized AI agents Hannah (marketing research) and Elena (operations/planning) via API or email
- Supports asynchronous task management with status tracking and result retrieval
- Enables multi-agent workflows, including Elena delegating to Hannah for research
- Includes example usage workflows, environment variable setup instructions, and agent best practices
- Requires human action to obtain and configure API keys and access
